descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon Trading Card Game card featuring Oricorio from the Surging Sparks set. The card is named "Sparks" and is a Pokémon card type. This collectible card game item is a sought-after addition for Pokémon TCG enthusiasts looking to enhance their collection with a unique and visually appealing card. The reverse holo design adds a special touch to this particular card, making it stand out among other cards in the game.
